div.div:
مَثْمُودٌ A water exhausted by the crowding of men to it, (S, M, K,) except the smaller portion of it. (S, K.) ―
-b2- And [hence,] (tropical:) A man exhausted of what he possessed, (T, S, M, A, K,) by his giving when asked, (M, K,) or in consequence of much begging. (T, S, M, A.) ―
-b3- And (tropical:) A man exhausted of his seminal fluid by women. (S, A, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
